assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: no
daemon_capability: n/a; driver_capability: n/a

## Reasoning

The scenario needs an agent run in a cloud VM or container with no local PID, observed through a remote feed. OpenCode 2.x has no such run mode: every session is hosted by a LOCAL `opencode serve --service` process and stored in that user's local SQLite store (session_v2/session_message under $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode). The daemon binds each session to that local service pid (pid.go servicePIDFor). There is no hosted, PID-less run to observe, so the cell is n/a on every axis — the same verdict as the V1 `opencode` column's 1-7 for the same reason, one layer earlier than irrlicht's missing remote transport.

## What would flip this

An upstream OpenCode hosted/cloud run mode with its own control plane and no local process; the daemon would then also need a non-file, non-store Source variant.
caveats: The 2.x service is long-lived and shared, but it is still a local process with a local store — do not mistake 'no per-session process' for 'PID-less'.

sources.note: servicePIDFor: a session no client runs binds to the one running service; OwnsSharedPID answers false for an archived row

2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
the V1 column's frozen n/a verdict, for the same reason

recipe.notes: agent_supports=no — OpenCode 2.x has no cloud/hosted run mode; every session is hosted by a local `serve --service` process over a local store, so there is nothing PID-less or remote to observe. No recipe; frozen at Stage 1, as the V1 opencode column is.
